prompt: Create a hyper-realistic street photograph of an elderly Japanese biker with slicked-back white hair, a gray goatee, black sunglasses, black leather gloves, black boots, dark jeans, and a black embroidered leather jacket sitting confidently on a bizarre custom motorcycle built entirely from vegetables, inspired by a modern Obon spirit horse. The motorcycle should look mechanically believable but organic: use exactly 2 giant glossy purple eggplants as the main body pieces, with one long eggplant forming the fuel tank and seat area and one upright eggplant forming the oversized front headlight cowling; use exactly 2 oversized dark-purple eggplant wheels, each covered in small round vegetable studs like tire knobs; use green cucumbers, zucchini, bamboo-like stalks, and eggplant stems as the handlebars, front forks, frame tubes, exhaust pipes, engine parts, spokes, foot pegs, and suspension. Add cut cucumber ends and green vegetable cross-sections as small mechanical details, bolts, caps, and pipe openings. The rider leans forward with both hands gripping the cucumber handlebars and one boot planted on the asphalt, giving the scene a cool outlaw biker attitude. Set the scene on a realistic urban Japanese street with a beige concrete wall, metal railing, sidewalk, and a partially visible parked black compact car in the background. Use natural overcast daylight, shallow depth of field, documentary realism, detailed vegetable textures, glossy eggplant skin, rough cucumber bumps, cinematic contrast, and a slightly low eye-level camera angle. No text, no watermark, no cartoon styling.

promptZh: 创作一张超写实的街头摄影作品，画面中 一位留着大背头白发、灰色山羊胡、戴着黑色墨镜、黑色皮手套、黑色靴子、深色牛仔裤，身穿黑色刺绣皮夹克的老年日本骑手 自信地坐在一辆完全由蔬菜打造的怪异定制摩托车上，灵感源自现代盂兰盆节的灵马。摩托车应看起来机械结构可信但具有有机质感：使用 2 个巨大的亮紫色茄子作为主体部件，其中一个长茄子构成油箱和座椅区域，另一个竖立的茄子构成超大的前大灯整流罩；使用 2 个超大的深紫色茄子作为车轮，每个车轮上覆盖着类似轮胎防滑钉的小圆蔬菜颗粒；使用绿黄瓜、西葫芦、竹状茎和茄子梗作为车把、前叉、车架管、排气管、发动机部件、辐条、脚踏和悬挂系统。添加切开的黄瓜末端和绿色蔬菜横截面作为细小的机械细节、螺栓、盖子和管道开口。骑手身体前倾，双手紧握黄瓜车把，一只靴子踩在柏油路面上，展现出酷炫的亡命之徒骑手姿态。场景设定在真实的日本城市街道上，背景为米色混凝土墙、金属护栏、人行道和部分可见的停放的黑色小型汽车。采用自然阴天光线、浅景深、纪录片式的写实风格、细腻的蔬菜纹理、茄子皮的光泽感、黄瓜粗糙的凸起、电影般的对比度，以及略微低平的拍摄视角。无文字，无水印，无卡通风格。
